description: This file defines a Java interface named EntityPopulator used for converting or mapping source objects to target objects within the system, specifically in the context of merchant store data. It declares two methods for populating entities from source data, possibly involving a merchant store context, and throws a ConversionException if the conversion fails.

classes.name: EntityPopulator
classes.description: A generic interface for populating target entities from source objects, potentially involving merchant store information.

methods.name: populateToEntity
methods.description: Converts a source object to a target entity, possibly integrating merchant store data, and may throw a ConversionException.

methods.name: populateToEntity
methods.description: Converts a source object to a target entity without additional context, can throw a ConversionException.
